title: A compactly carried integer multiplicity cycle annihilates every exact smooth form (cutoff step of Simon 6.2.23–2.24)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ. Let X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) be a current in ℝ^P (GeometricCurrentOn univ (k+1)), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ (k+1)) representing X, i.e. X(ω) = R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dH^{k+1}(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^P). Let K ⊆ ℝ^P be compact with μ_R(ℝ^P ∖ K) = 0, where μ_R = θH^{k+1}⌞M (R.measure). If ∂X = 0 (X.boundary = 0), then R.action(dη) = ∫_M θ⟨dη, ξ⟩ dH^{k+1} = 0 for every smooth k-form η on ℝ^P (IsSmoothForm η: C^∞, with no support condition), where dη = exteriorDerivative η.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k), R.Represents X → IsCompact K → R.measure Kᶜ = 0 → X.boundary = 0 → IsSmoothForm η → R.action (exteriorDerivative η) = 0
